name: 亮马河夜景
experience_value: Gives couple routes a modern Beijing closure that feels composed, illuminated, and emotionally distinct from hutong nostalgia.
Useful when the itinerary needs a final-night mood asset rather than another daytime cultural anchor.
Adds contemporary city atmosphere without forcing the route into a full nightlife or shopping story.
avoid_when: the route is intentionally focused on old Beijing texture and should not end in a modern-city register
winter weather weakens the waterside evening payoff too much
the day already ends with a strong historic waterfront closure and would duplicate emotional function
